specs.title: D31-SETUP: customer registers with Google; the free company is active immediately
D31-TEMPLATE: all three real templates are shown and one must be chosen before details
D31-CREATE: design + details + photo + custom address → created, published, QR
D31-PUBLIC: a clean, never-signed-in browser sees the real card with its photo
D31-SLUG: Card Link ID is suggested from the name, checked inline, and a typed ID is never replaced
D31-EDIT: editing an employee keeps the card design unless it is changed
D31-INACTIVE: a deactivated employee is unavailable publicly and the panel says why; activation restores it
D31-UNPUBLISH: unpublish hides the card, republish restores the same address
D34-E2E-1: Create Free Card with Google makes an active individual account, no company, no demo data
D34-E2E-2: Register as Company with Google opens an active company workspace (Free plan)
D34-E2E-3: the same Google identity registering again is told it already has a workspace; still one company
D34-E2E-4: an unknown Google identity at Login as Company is not authorized and gets no account
D34-E2E-5: closing the Google popup shows no error and stays on the sign-in screen
D34-E2E-6: the sign-in screen at 360x740 has no horizontal scroll and every Google button is at least 44px tall
D34-E2E-7: a password account signs in by email, links Google (same UID), then signs in with Google to the same workspace
Browser A: company registers, builds and publishes its website
Browser B: the real company website appears for an anonymous visitor
Browser A: adds an employee and publishes the card
Browser B: the real employee card appears; website → card → website loop works
Browser B: enquiry from the website reaches customer A
Browser C: a second customer builds its own site and never sees customer A data
Browser E: a third customer builds its own site; three-way isolation holds
unpublished, preview and unknown URLs never show content or demo data
Browser D: App Owner sees all three pilots demo ready
EV-1: an unverified account is told to verify, can resend, and has no App Owner authority
EV-2: the emailed link verifies the account; the app picks it up; still no App Owner authority
EV-3: only the server/admin grant confers App Owner, and only after a fresh sign-in
REH-R1: customer registers, creates the company, adds an employee, publishes card and website
REH-R2: customer registers, creates the company, adds an employee, publishes card and website
REH-R3: customer registers, creates the company, adds an employee, publishes card and website
REH-SERVER: each employee and card belongs to exactly its own company
REH-PUBLIC: every website, card and profile renders in a clean browser with only its own data
REH-NAV: website → employee card → website navigation uses canonical paths
REH-PERSIST: customer data survives a reload and a brand-new browser
REH-UNPUBLISH: unpublished content disappears from clean browsers; ?preview=true is no bypass
REH-404: unknown slugs and paths show not-found pages, never demo content
REH-LEGACY: old hash links still open and are rewritten to the canonical path
REH-OWNER: the App Owner sees all three customers correctly and measured platform health
